newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China RPI seen at 2.0 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China RPI seen at 2.0 pct in first half.

text.p: China's benchmark retail price inflation is forecast to grow by a year-on-year two percent in the first half, the Financial News said on Tuesday quoting a survey by the Information Department of the State Economic and Trade Commission.
Retail price inflation rose 2.6 percent for the first quarter compared with the year-ago period, while consumer price inflation was 5.2 percent.
The government has set a target of six percent for 1997 compared with 6.1 percent last year, but economists have said the rates could be as low as three to four percent this year.
